title: Anthony Richardson's trade request hasn't been rescinded, Colts intend to keep three QBs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Anthony Richardson's trade request hasn't been rescinded, Colts intend to keep three QBs
sources.description: Anthony Richardson requested a trade this offseason, but he remains on the Colts' roster and it doesn't sound like any move involving the quarterback is imminent.
